Set a bounded courtyard cut so the void is legible but the mass remains compact.

Reduce the abruptness of the bend so the silhouette reads as one continuous occupiable mass rather than a brittle tier.
Keep the bend aligned to the long direction so the mass maintains a readable primary gesture.
Increase continuity in the bend resolution to avoid an over-broken profile.
Convert the terminal mass response into a public void strategy that better addresses the verified access edge and creates a legible ground threshold.

rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent compact mass in all four views, so it avoids fragmentation and gross view-to-view collisions. However, it behaves mostly like a generic stacked box with a mild bend/step at the top rather than a neighborhood-living mass with an active ground threshold. The verified access edge is not answered by a clear void, seam, undercut, or court; instead the access side is effectively sealed. The dominant gesture is understandable, but the open-space figure and public ground response are too weak for the brief. The silhouette is acceptable as an early massing idea, but it does not yet express a convincing program section or public-private hierarchy. The form also does not meaningfully exploit the parcel orientation beyond simple containment.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is taller and more tower-like; candidate is much lower and lacks the strong public/ground articulation that makes the precedent work.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stacked, slightly tapered mixed-use massing with a legible upper profile and compact footprint.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Candidate is not a tower and does not share the tall slender profile or riverfront urban presence.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A singular vertical mass can be acceptable when it preserves a coherent dominant figure and reads as one continuous section.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Candidate has no comparable open edge, canopy, or street-facing active seam; the reference is materially more porous at grade.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Clear ground-level public threshold and simple primary mass with an adjacent expressive element can support neighborhood-serving use.

warnings: Parcel containment appears acceptable, but the access edge response is semantically weak.
Do not read the stepped upper volume as a sufficient public-space or section strategy; it is not yet programmatic.
The mass is coherent, but the ground condition needs a legible carve, notch, courtyard, or split to satisfy the brief.
